approvalRef: Organization supplement development procedure — filling instructions
description: Supplement should not exceed 10 pages; if it does, the FAA office must be notified of the total page count.
findingText: The PMA supplement exceeds 10 pages and the FAA office has not been recorded as notified of the total page count.
resolutionHint: Notify the FAA certificate management office of the total number of pages, and record that notification on the case.
clauseRefs: Organization supplement development procedure — filling instructions
limitations: SOP-851-12 permits exceeding 10 pages provided the office is notified; this is advisory, not a hard stop.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
